purpose: Additive Phase-8D audit gap registry: eight AUDIT-8D findings with reproduction status, confidence, dependencies, historical lineage and concrete experiments. The historical Phase-7 registry is read-only and is never rewritten; no record is promoted to a capability.

records.existing_capability: Phase-8C emits per-public-sample stage metrics and hidden aggregate-only counts; hidden per-stage attribution is not implemented and hidden per-sample identifiers must stay private.
limitations: hidden stage attribution must remain aggregate-only; private sample ids/paths cannot be public
a zero-candidate result is a measured coverage gap, not a capability success
records.observed_failure: The final hidden lane executed 8 samples (6 runtime, 2 analysis-only) but produced 0 candidates and 0 independent verifications. The public aggregate has only final status counts/rates; it cannot attribute the zero-candidate outcome to detection, root-cause, localization, strategy, candidate generation or verification. A zero result without stage attribution is an evaluation gap, not evidence of capability.

steps: extend the hidden aggregate with private-stage counters for detection, root cause, localization, strategy and candidate generation, and publish only the aggregate counts
replay the final hidden lane with D00/D01 instrumentation and verify the counters sum to the 8 executed samples without exposing per-sample ids
record stage attribution as evidence; do not promote any capability from the hidden result

records.existing_capability: Phase-8B/C verifier fails closed and the benchmark runner withdraws the deterministic claim; no root-cause probe classifies the ABI rejection.
limitations: no verifier loosening is permitted; a root-cause explanation does not verify the candidate
ABI evidence unavailable must remain not_run, never pass
records.observed_failure: The public heap-malloc candidate was claimed deterministic-verified, then independently rejected by the ABI check with branch_target_unknown, call_target_not_allowed and no_ret. The disagreement is preserved, but no root-cause classification exists yet, so it is unclear whether the engine's plan omitted ABI evidence, the verifier required evidence the sample cannot supply, or both.

steps: replay the exact heap-malloc candidate/plan/verifier metadata without changing verifier acceptance rules
classify the rejection as engine-plan omission, verifier-evidence limitation or sample limitation using provenance evidence
add the classification to the finding and rerun the benchmark; keep published false_verified=0 and the withdrawal intact

records.existing_capability: Three deterministic mechanisms produce 64 records; four mechanisms are not_run and must not be counted as zero-gap evidence.
limitations: no fabricated mutation/metamorphic corpus; absent corpora remain not_run
discovery candidates are never capability promotion evidence
records.observed_failure: The historical discovery report runs only knowledge, failure_driven and differential (3/7). Mutation, metamorphic, sample_based and knowledge_source_scan are explicit not_run with no engine/corpus; the absence of four mechanisms means the capability space is only partially searched.

steps: implement one deterministic mutation/metamorphic adapter with a versioned local corpus and provenance
implement sample_based/knowledge_source_scan only when a local, licensed corpus/feed is provisioned; otherwise keep explicit not_run
run all mechanisms together and compare newly discovered gaps against the historical registry without rewriting it

records.existing_capability: 13 positive and 49 negative cases exist; there is no measured valid-repair-acceptance suite or False Reject rate.
limitations: a valid-repair fixture needs independent review; generator-only self-acceptance is not evidence
false-reject coverage is not a capability promotion
records.observed_failure: The acceptance audit covers 62 positive/negative cases across AM01-AM28 with precision/recall 1.0, but it has no systematic False Reject set: valid repairs that a correct rule must accept are not independently tested as a class. A rule set can reject all repairs and still pass the current negative-heavy matrix.

steps: construct independently reviewed valid-repair fixtures whose acceptance is required for each affected AM class
add a false-reject metric and a differential valid-vs-invalid decision table; never pass by rejecting all inputs
run the suite and publish false_reject_count/rate with failures counted, not hidden

records.existing_capability: 62 static cases; no acceptance mutation harness, no threshold/scope mutation results, no negative test of the acceptance rule engine.
limitations: rule mutation is a test of the acceptance model, not a license to change production thresholds
mutation survival=0 is required before any promotion evidence is trusted
records.observed_failure: The acceptance model has no systematic rule-mutation suite: thresholds, scope rules and required-evidence gates are not deliberately weakened/altered to prove the audit still rejects invalid candidates. The current audit tests known invalid fixtures, not the audit's own rules.

steps: inject bounded mutations into thresholds, scope checks and required-evidence rules in a test-only copy
verify the audit detects every mutation that would admit an invalid candidate and that legal-rule changes are review-gated
record mutation survival counts and never mutate the production acceptance model

records.existing_capability: Reflection produces analysis-only records; verified is always false and no experiment execution or result analyzer exists.
limitations: executing a reflection experiment does not promote a capability
untrusted experiment output must not be treated as verification without an independent verifier
records.observed_failure: The reflection artifact contains 101 records and 12 candidate decisions with proposed experiments, but there is no execution runner/result artifact: plans are not executed, falsification conditions are not evaluated, and no regression/promotion decision follows from them.

steps: select one bounded proposed experiment with a falsification condition and an isolated fixture
execute it in a sandboxed runner and persist input/output/exit/oracle evidence under a new artifact directory
feed the result back into reflection only as an analysis input; any capability change still needs the promotion gate

records.existing_capability: Phase-8B/C evidence records verified/rejected/not_run but there is no promotion state machine, no auto-promotion ban, and no independent approval contract.
limitations: a gate decision is not a capability claim; promoted remains false until independent approval
hidden evidence cannot be exposed per sample just to satisfy generalization
records.observed_failure: No promotion gate enforces discovered -> analysis_only -> candidate_generated -> independently_verified -> generalized -> promoted. There is no legal-transition checker, no evidence requirements per level, no hidden/holdout and regression requirements, and no independent/human approval for promotion. A record can therefore be described as a capability without a verifiable state history.

steps: implement the additive promotion_gate service with legal transitions, per-level evidence requirements and an independent-approval field

evaluate the Phase-8C public/hidden evidence: independently_verified may be reached only by public fixture evidence; generalized must fail while hidden verified=0; promoted must fail without independent approval
publish denied/allowed decisions; never auto-promote and never treat not_run as pass

records.existing_capability: C4/C5 enforce 0700, public commitment and contamination checks at build time; no independent Phase-8D isolation audit artifact exists.
limitations: operational isolation is not cryptographic; same-UID/root readers remain a limitation
the audit must not copy hidden bytes, sample ids or private paths into public artifacts
records.observed_failure: The hidden corpus root is 0700 and commitment-only publicly, but isolation is operational: same-UID/root readers can inspect it, and no automated audit checks root permissions, commitment/aggregate consistency, public leakage and material integrity together. A clean hidden contamination result is not a cryptographic isolation proof.

steps: implement a read-only audit for root mode, commitment/aggregate consistency, private material integrity and public leak scanning
fail closed on 0700 violation, tamper, missing commitment or hidden id/path leakage; record operational-not-cryptographic limitation explicitly
run it against the real private root read-only and publish only the audit summary/hashes
